title: 光學同調斷層掃描~Optical coherence tomography
focus: 低同調干涉的軸向解析度、頻域深度範圍、靈敏度衰減與色散預算~Axial resolution of low-coherence interferometry, Fourier-domain depth range, sensitivity roll-off and dispersion budgets
summary: 從寬頻光源的同調長度推出 OCT 的軸向解析度，理解頻域偵測如何把深度編碼成光譜干涉頻率、為何光譜儀的像素間距決定深度範圍與靈敏度衰減，再把光源頻寬、光譜儀色散、散粒雜訊極限、兩臂色散匹配與掃描光學整合成可驗收的斷層影像系統。~Derive the axial resolution of OCT from the coherence length of a broadband source, see how Fourier-domain detection encodes depth as spectral interference frequency and why spectrometer pixel spacing sets depth range and sensitivity roll-off, then integrate source bandwidth, spectrometer dispersion, the shot-noise limit, arm dispersion matching and scanning optics into an acceptable tomographic imaging system.

units.anchor: 寬頻光源與同調包絡~Broadband source and coherence envelope
units.title: 低同調干涉與軸向解析度~Low-coherence interference and axial resolution
units.mechanism: OCT 是邁克森干涉儀的延伸：樣品臂的背向散射光只在與參考臂光程差小於光源同調長度時才產生干涉，因此干涉包絡的寬度就是深度方向的解析度，與物鏡數值孔徑無關。軸向解析度由中心波長與頻寬決定，橫向解析度則由聚焦光斑決定，兩者可以獨立設計；這正是 OCT 能用低數值孔徑光學取得微米級深度解析的原因。~OCT extends the Michelson interferometer: backscattered light from the sample arm interferes only when its path differs from the reference arm by less than the source coherence length, so the width of the interference envelope is the depth resolution, independent of objective numerical aperture. Axial resolution is set by centre wavelength and bandwidth, lateral resolution by the focused spot, and the two can be designed independently; this is why OCT achieves micrometre depth resolution with low-NA optics.
units.model: 高斯光譜的軸向解析度 δz = (2·ln2/π)·λ₀²/Δλ = 0.441·λ₀²/Δλ：λ₀ = 840 nm、Δλ = 50 nm 時 δz ≈ 0.441×0.84²/0.050 µm ≈ 6.2 µm（空氣），組織 n = 1.38 內約 4.5 µm；1310 nm、Δλ = 100 nm 則約 7.6 µm。橫向光斑 Δx ≈ (4/π)·λ₀·f/d，f = 36 mm、d = 1.2 mm 時 Δx ≈ 32 µm，對應焦深 2z_R = 2π·w₀²/λ₀ ≈ 1.9 mm。~For a Gaussian spectrum the axial resolution is δz = (2·ln2/π)·λ₀²/Δλ = 0.441·λ₀²/Δλ: with λ₀ = 840 nm and Δλ = 50 nm, δz ≈ 0.441×0.84²/0.050 µm ≈ 6.2 µm in air, about 4.5 µm inside tissue with n = 1.38; at 1310 nm with Δλ = 100 nm it is about 7.6 µm. The lateral spot Δx ≈ (4/π)·λ₀·f/d is about 32 µm for f = 36 mm and d = 1.2 mm, with a depth of focus 2z_R = 2π·w₀²/λ₀ ≈ 1.9 mm.
units.verify: 把一面鏡子放在樣品臂並取得單一反射的軸向點擴散函數，量其半高寬並與 0.441·λ₀²/Δλ 比較；同時用光譜儀量光源的實際頻寬與形狀，若光譜非高斯則預期出現旁瓣，應一併記錄旁瓣高度。~Place a mirror in the sample arm, acquire the axial point-spread function of the single reflection, measure its FWHM and compare with 0.441·λ₀²/Δλ; also measure the source bandwidth and shape on a spectrometer, and if the spectrum is non-Gaussian expect and record the side-lobe level.
units.failure: 用頻寬標示值而非實測頻寬估算解析度，再加上光譜被濾波或耦合器裁切，實際 δz 可能比預期差 30% 以上，薄層結構無法分辨。~Estimating resolution from the nominal rather than the measured bandwidth, with the spectrum further clipped by filters or couplers, can make the real δz more than 30% worse than expected, so thin layers are not resolved.
units.misconception: 提高物鏡數值孔徑可以改善 OCT 的軸向解析度。~Raising the objective numerical aperture improves OCT axial resolution.

units.anchor: 光譜干涉圖與傅立葉轉換~Spectral interferogram and Fourier transform
units.title: 頻域 OCT 的深度編碼與靈敏度衰減~Depth encoding and sensitivity roll-off in Fourier-domain OCT
units.mechanism: 頻域 OCT 不移動參考鏡，而是記錄整個光譜的干涉圖 I(k) ∝ S(k)[1 + Σ2√(R_r·R_n)·cos(2k·z_n) + …]；每個深度 z_n 對應光譜中一個頻率 2z_n，對 k 做傅立葉轉換即得到整條深度剖面。因為所有深度同時偵測，靈敏度比時域 OCT 高出 N/2 倍；但光譜儀有限的解析度讓高頻干涉條紋被平滑，深度越大、訊號越弱，這就是靈敏度衰減。~Fourier-domain OCT keeps the reference mirror fixed and records the interferogram across the spectrum, I(k) ∝ S(k)[1 + Σ2√(R_r·R_n)·cos(2k·z_n) + …]; each depth z_n maps to a spectral frequency 2z_n, and a Fourier transform over k returns the whole depth profile. Because all depths are detected simultaneously the sensitivity exceeds time-domain OCT by N/2; but the finite spectral resolution of the spectrometer smooths the high-frequency fringes, so signal falls with depth, which is the sensitivity roll-off.
units.model: 深度範圍 z_max = λ₀²/(4·n·δλ)：λ₀ = 840 nm、每像素 δλ = 0.050 nm 時 z_max ≈ 0.7056/(4×5×10⁻⁵) µm ≈ 3.5 mm（空氣）。N = 2048 像素的靈敏度增益 10·log₁₀(N/2) ≈ 30 dB。衰減 R(z) = [sinζ/ζ]²·exp[−w²ζ²/(2ln2)]，ζ = (π/2)·z/z_max，w 為光譜解析度與像素間距之比；w = 1.5 時半深度處約 −5.3 dB，全深度處約 −21 dB。~Depth range z_max = λ₀²/(4·n·δλ): for λ₀ = 840 nm and δλ = 0.050 nm per pixel, z_max ≈ 0.7056/(4×5×10⁻⁵) µm ≈ 3.5 mm in air. With N = 2048 pixels the sensitivity gain is 10·log₁₀(N/2) ≈ 30 dB. Roll-off is R(z) = [sinζ/ζ]²·exp[−w²ζ²/(2ln2)] with ζ = (π/2)·z/z_max and w the ratio of spectral resolution to pixel spacing; for w = 1.5 it is about −5.3 dB at half depth and about −21 dB at full depth.
units.verify: 以鏡面反射在不同參考臂位置取得峰值，畫出峰值強度對深度的曲線並擬合 sinc² 與高斯項，反推 w 值；再把量到的 z_max 與 λ₀²/(4·δλ) 比較，確認光譜儀像素間距的校正值。~Record the mirror peak at a series of reference-arm positions, plot peak intensity against depth, fit the sinc² and Gaussian terms to extract w; then compare the measured z_max with λ₀²/(4·δλ) to confirm the calibrated spectrometer pixel spacing.
units.failure: 把樣品放在接近 z_max 的位置成像，訊號比零深度處低 20 dB 以上，深層結構消失，而且超過 z_max 的訊號會鏡像摺疊回影像中造成假結構。~Imaging a sample placed near z_max loses more than 20 dB relative to zero depth so deep structures vanish, and signal beyond z_max folds back as a mirror image that creates false structures.
units.misconception: 頻域 OCT 的影像深度只受光在組織中的穿透限制。~In Fourier-domain OCT the imaging depth is limited only by light penetration into tissue.

units.anchor: 超輻射二極體與光譜形狀~Superluminescent diode and spectral shape
units.title: 寬頻光源、頻寬與深度範圍的取捨~Broadband source, bandwidth and the depth-range trade-off
units.mechanism: 超輻射二極體提供數十奈米的頻寬與毫瓦級功率，掃頻雷射則以時間掃描波長；兩者都要求光譜平滑、無漣波，因為光譜上的任何週期結構會在深度剖面上變成假峰。頻寬加大能縮小 δz，但固定像素數的光譜儀必須覆蓋更寬的波段，每像素的 δλ 隨之變大、深度範圍縮小，所以頻寬選擇是解析度與深度範圍的直接取捨；眼睛的安全曝光上限又限制了可用功率。~Superluminescent diodes deliver tens of nanometres of bandwidth at milliwatt power, while swept lasers scan wavelength in time; both need smooth, ripple-free spectra because any periodic spectral structure becomes a false peak in the depth profile. Wider bandwidth shrinks δz, but a spectrometer with a fixed pixel count must cover a wider band, so δλ per pixel grows and depth range shrinks; bandwidth choice is a direct trade between resolution and depth range, and ocular exposure limits cap the usable power.
units.model: 在 λ₀ = 840 nm：Δλ = 50、100、150 nm 分別給 δz ≈ 6.2、3.1、2.1 µm。若 2048 像素光譜儀覆蓋 100 nm，δλ = 0.0488 nm、z_max ≈ 3.6 mm；覆蓋 200 nm 以容納更寬光源時 δλ = 0.0977 nm、z_max ≈ 1.8 mm。每個 840 nm 光子能量 hc/λ ≈ 2.36×10⁻¹⁹ J，1 mW 相當於每秒 4.2×10¹⁵ 個光子。~At λ₀ = 840 nm, Δλ = 50, 100 and 150 nm give δz ≈ 6.2, 3.1 and 2.1 µm. If a 2048-pixel spectrometer spans 100 nm, δλ = 0.0488 nm and z_max ≈ 3.6 mm; spanning 200 nm to admit a broader source gives δλ = 0.0977 nm and z_max ≈ 1.8 mm. Each 840 nm photon carries hc/λ ≈ 2.36×10⁻¹⁹ J, so 1 mW is 4.2×10¹⁵ photons per second.
units.verify: 用光譜分析儀量光源光譜的半高寬與漣波深度，計算預期 δz 與假峰位置（漣波週期 δλ_r 對應深度 λ₀²/(2·δλ_r)），再以鏡面點擴散函數確認旁瓣與假峰低於主峰 30 dB 以上。~Measure the source FWHM and ripple depth on an optical spectrum analyser, compute the expected δz and the ghost-peak position (a ripple period δλ_r maps to depth λ₀²/(2·δλ_r)), then confirm with a mirror point-spread function that side lobes and ghost peaks sit more than 30 dB below the main peak.
units.failure: 光源驅動電流或溫度漂移使光譜重心移動與頻寬縮小，δz 變差且深度比例尺改變；光纖端面的回光進入超輻射二極體則造成光譜漣波與整幅影像的固定假層。~Drift of drive current or temperature shifts the spectral centroid and narrows the bandwidth, degrading δz and changing the depth scale; back-reflection from a fibre facet into the superluminescent diode adds spectral ripple that appears as a fixed false layer across the image.
units.misconception: 光源頻寬越寬，系統在任何深度的影像都一定越好。~A broader source always gives a better image at every depth.

units.anchor: 光柵光譜儀與線型相機~Grating spectrometer and line camera
units.title: 光譜儀色散、像素取樣與 k 線性化~Spectrometer dispersion, pixel sampling and k-linearization
units.mechanism: 光譜域 OCT 的光譜儀由準直鏡、繞射光柵、聚焦鏡與線型相機組成；光柵方程式 sinα + sinβ = mλ/d 給出偏向角，線色散 dλ/dx = d·cosβ/(m·f) 決定每個像素覆蓋的波長。相機像素在波長上等距，但傅立葉轉換需要在波數 k = 2π/λ 上等距，所以在轉換前必須重新取樣；省略這一步，點擴散函數會隨深度迅速變寬。光譜儀的聚焦品質決定 w 值，也就是衰減速率。~The spectrometer of spectral-domain OCT consists of a collimator, a diffraction grating, a focusing lens and a line camera; the grating equation sinα + sinβ = mλ/d gives the diffraction angle and the linear dispersion dλ/dx = d·cosβ/(m·f) sets the wavelength per pixel. Camera pixels are equally spaced in wavelength but the Fourier transform needs equal spacing in wavenumber k = 2π/λ, so the data must be resampled before transforming; skipping this step broadens the point-spread function rapidly with depth. The focusing quality of the spectrometer sets w and therefore the roll-off rate.
units.model: 1200 線/mm 光柵（d = 0.833 µm）、α = 30°、λ = 840 nm：sinβ = 1.008 − 0.5 = 0.508，β ≈ 30.5°，cosβ ≈ 0.861。聚焦鏡 f = 200 mm 時 dλ/dx = 0.833×0.861/200 ≈ 3.59 nm/mm，14 µm 像素對應 0.050 nm，2048 像素覆蓋 103 nm，z_max ≈ 3.5 mm。波段兩端 790 與 890 nm 的 k 間距比為 (890/790)² ≈ 1.27，即 27% 的非線性必須重新取樣。~A 1200 line/mm grating (d = 0.833 µm) at α = 30° and λ = 840 nm gives sinβ = 1.008 − 0.5 = 0.508, β ≈ 30.5°, cosβ ≈ 0.861. With a 200 mm focusing lens, dλ/dx = 0.833×0.861/200 ≈ 3.59 nm/mm, so a 14 µm pixel spans 0.050 nm, 2048 pixels cover 103 nm and z_max ≈ 3.5 mm. Between 790 and 890 nm the k spacing per pixel changes by (890/790)² ≈ 1.27, a 27% nonlinearity that must be resampled.
units.verify: 用已知譜線（例如氬或氖燈）或窄線寬雷射標定像素對波長的多項式，再把鏡面干涉圖直接轉換與重新取樣後轉換各做一次，比較不同深度的峰寬；正確線性化後峰寬應只隨衰減模型緩慢變化。~Calibrate the pixel-to-wavelength polynomial with known lines such as an argon or neon lamp or a narrow-linewidth laser, then transform a mirror interferogram once directly and once after resampling and compare peak widths at several depths; after correct linearization the width should change only slowly according to the roll-off model.
units.failure: 線型相機或光柵因溫度漂移使光譜在像素上平移半個像素，固定的 k 標定失效，深層峰值變寬且深度比例尺出現約 0.5% 的誤差，層厚量測系統性偏差。~Thermal drift that shifts the spectrum by half a pixel on the camera or grating invalidates the fixed k calibration; deep peaks broaden and the depth scale acquires an error of about 0.5%, biasing every layer-thickness measurement.
units.misconception: 光譜儀像素越多，深度解析度就越高。~More spectrometer pixels give finer depth resolution.

units.anchor: 散粒雜訊極限與靈敏度量測~Shot-noise limit and sensitivity measurement
units.title: 靈敏度、散粒雜訊極限與功率預算~Sensitivity, shot-noise limit and power budget
units.mechanism: 靈敏度定義為能以信噪比 1 偵測的最小樣品反射率，常以 dB 表示。當參考光足夠強使散粒雜訊主導時，靈敏度極限只取決於樣品臂回到偵測器的光子數：功率乘上曝光時間、除以光子能量、再乘上偵測效率。實際系統因耦合器分光、光譜儀效率與相機量子效率而低於極限數 dB，差距就是損耗預算；更高的 A 掃描速率縮短曝光時間，靈敏度按比例下降。~Sensitivity is the smallest sample reflectivity detectable at unit signal-to-noise ratio, usually quoted in dB. When the reference beam is strong enough for shot noise to dominate, the limit depends only on the number of sample-arm photons reaching the detector: power times exposure time divided by photon energy, times detection efficiency. Real systems fall a few dB short because of coupler splitting, spectrometer efficiency and camera quantum efficiency, and that gap is the loss budget; higher A-scan rates shorten the exposure and lower sensitivity proportionally.
units.model: 散粒雜訊極限 Σ = η·P_s·τ/E_ph：P_s = 0.7 mW、τ = 14.3 µs（70 kHz A 掃描）、E_ph = 2.36×10⁻¹⁹ J、η = 0.8 時，光子數 ≈ 4.2×10¹⁰，Σ ≈ 3.4×10¹⁰ → 10·log₁₀ ≈ 105 dB。實測 98 dB 表示有 7 dB 損耗，其中 50/50 耦合器雙程約 6 dB，其餘歸於光譜儀效率；提高到 140 kHz 則極限再降 3 dB。~Shot-noise limit Σ = η·P_s·τ/E_ph: with P_s = 0.7 mW, τ = 14.3 µs (70 kHz A-scan rate), E_ph = 2.36×10⁻¹⁹ J and η = 0.8, the photon number is about 4.2×10¹⁰ and Σ ≈ 3.4×10¹⁰, i.e. 10·log₁₀ ≈ 105 dB. A measured 98 dB implies a 7 dB loss, of which the double pass through a 50/50 coupler accounts for about 6 dB and the rest for spectrometer efficiency; doubling the rate to 140 kHz lowers the limit by 3 dB.
units.verify: 樣品臂放鏡子並加一片 OD 2 中性濾鏡（雙程 −40 dB），量峰值高於雜訊底的 dB 數再加 40 dB 得靈敏度；與散粒雜訊極限比較，並以功率計逐段量測耦合器、光纖與光譜儀的損耗，確認差距可被損耗預算解釋。~Put a mirror in the sample arm behind an OD 2 neutral-density filter (−40 dB double pass), read the peak above the noise floor in dB and add 40 dB to obtain sensitivity; compare with the shot-noise limit and measure coupler, fibre and spectrometer losses stage by stage with a power meter to confirm the gap matches the loss budget.
units.failure: 參考光太強使相機飽和或進入過量雜訊區，或太弱使讀出雜訊主導，兩者都讓靈敏度偏離散粒雜訊極限 5 到 10 dB，深層弱散射組織消失在雜訊底之下。~A reference beam strong enough to saturate the camera or enter the excess-noise regime, or weak enough for read noise to dominate, pushes sensitivity 5 to 10 dB away from the shot-noise limit, and weakly scattering deep tissue disappears below the noise floor.
units.misconception: 增加樣品臂功率可以無限制提高靈敏度。~Sensitivity can be raised without limit by increasing sample-arm power.

units.anchor: 色散補償玻璃與點擴散函數~Dispersion-compensation glass and PSF
units.title: 兩臂色散匹配與解析度誤差預算~Arm dispersion matching and the resolution error budget
units.mechanism: 參考臂與樣品臂若通過不同長度的玻璃、光纖或水，群速度色散會在干涉光譜上加入二次相位，使同調包絡像被啁啾的脈衝一樣展寬，軸向解析度變差且峰值下降。補償方法是在參考臂放入等效材料與長度的玻璃或水槽，或在重建時用數值方式乘上反向的二次相位並以峰值銳度最佳化係數。解析度預算需把光源頻寬實測值、殘留色散與光譜儀 k 標定誤差逐項列入。~If reference and sample arms traverse different lengths of glass, fibre or water, group-velocity dispersion adds a quadratic phase across the interference spectrum, broadening the coherence envelope like a chirped pulse and lowering the peak. Compensation places glass or a water cell of equivalent material and length in the reference arm, or numerically multiplies by the inverse quadratic phase with coefficients optimized for peak sharpness. The resolution budget must list the measured source bandwidth, residual dispersion and the spectrometer k-calibration error item by item.
units.model: δz = 6.2 µm 對應雙程包絡寬度 12.4 µm，即 τ₀ ≈ 41.5 fs。樣品臂多出 20 mm BK7（840 nm 群速度色散取約 40 fs²/mm）雙程產生 φ₂ ≈ 1600 fs²，包絡展寬為 τ = τ₀·√(1 + (4ln2·φ₂/τ₀²)²) = 41.5×√(1 + 2.58²) ≈ 115 fs，δz 變為約 17 µm，差 2.8 倍；補償到殘留 100 fs² 時展寬僅 1.3%。~δz = 6.2 µm corresponds to a double-pass envelope of 12.4 µm, i.e. τ₀ ≈ 41.5 fs. An extra 20 mm of BK7 in the sample arm (group-velocity dispersion taken as about 40 fs²/mm at 840 nm) gives φ₂ ≈ 1600 fs² over the double pass, broadening the envelope to τ = τ₀·√(1 + (4ln2·φ₂/τ₀²)²) = 41.5×√(1 + 2.58²) ≈ 115 fs, so δz grows to about 17 µm, 2.8 times worse; compensating to a residual of 100 fs² leaves only 1.3% broadening.
units.verify: 以鏡面點擴散函數為指標，逐步加入補償玻璃或調整數值二次相位係數，記錄峰寬與峰高隨補償量的曲線，取峰寬最小處為匹配點；再在數個深度重複，確認殘留三次色散不造成峰形不對稱。~Use the mirror point-spread function as the metric, add compensation glass or adjust the numerical quadratic-phase coefficient step by step, record peak width and height against compensation, and take the minimum width as the match point; repeat at several depths to confirm that residual third-order dispersion does not skew the peak.
units.failure: 只在零深度最佳化數值色散補償，卻忽略樣品本身（例如 24 mm 眼軸的水）的色散，視網膜層的點擴散函數比角膜處寬兩倍以上，層厚量測失準。~Optimizing numerical dispersion compensation only at zero depth while ignoring the sample's own dispersion, such as the 24 mm of water in an eye, leaves the retinal point-spread function more than twice as wide as at the cornea and corrupts layer-thickness measurements.
units.misconception: 只要兩臂光程相等，色散就自動匹配。~Equal arm path lengths automatically match dispersion.

units.anchor: 振鏡掃描與眼底成像光學~Galvo scanner and retinal imaging optics
units.title: 掃描光學、取樣與體積成像時序~Scanning optics, sampling and volumetric timing
units.mechanism: 樣品臂以一對振鏡在物鏡（眼底成像時是眼睛本身）的瞳孔共軛面上偏轉光束，掃描透鏡與中繼光學把偏轉角轉成視網膜上的位置。光斑大小由入瞳光束直徑與焦距決定，必須刻意保持低數值孔徑，讓焦深覆蓋整個感興趣的深度；橫向取樣間距需小於光斑的一半，否則細節混疊。A 掃描速率、每幅 B 掃描的 A 掃描數與體積大小共同決定擷取時間，而受測者的眼動限制了可接受的時間。~The sample arm deflects the beam with a galvanometer pair at a pupil-conjugate plane of the objective, which for retinal imaging is the eye itself, and the scan lens and relay optics convert angle into position on the retina. Spot size follows from the entrance-beam diameter and focal length, and the numerical aperture is deliberately kept low so that the depth of focus spans the whole depth of interest; lateral sampling must be finer than half the spot or detail aliases. A-scan rate, A-scans per B-scan and volume size set acquisition time, which subject eye motion bounds.
units.model: 眼睛 f ≈ 17 mm、角膜處光束直徑 d = 1.2 mm、λ₀ = 840 nm：光斑 Δx = (4/π)·λ₀·f/d ≈ 15 µm，w₀ ≈ 7.6 µm，焦深 2z_R = 2π·w₀²/λ₀ ≈ 0.43 mm，足以涵蓋約 0.3 mm 厚的視網膜。70 kHz 下 512 條 A 掃描的 B 掃描需 7.3 ms，512×512 體積需 3.7 s；6 mm 掃描寬度分 512 條時間距 11.7 µm 接近光斑，要達奈奎斯特取樣應用 1024 條。~For an eye with f ≈ 17 mm, a 1.2 mm beam at the cornea and λ₀ = 840 nm, the spot is Δx = (4/π)·λ₀·f/d ≈ 15 µm, w₀ ≈ 7.6 µm, and the depth of focus 2z_R = 2π·w₀²/λ₀ ≈ 0.43 mm covers the roughly 0.3 mm thick retina. At 70 kHz a 512-A-scan B-scan takes 7.3 ms and a 512×512 volume 3.7 s; a 6 mm scan with 512 lines has an 11.7 µm pitch close to the spot, so Nyquist sampling calls for 1024 lines.
units.verify: 用已知線距的光柵或刻度標板校正振鏡角度對位置的比例與線性度，用次解析度散射點量橫向點擴散函數並與 Δx 比較；再以固定相位目標記錄多幅 B 掃描，統計振鏡回程與時序抖動造成的位置重複性。~Calibrate the galvanometer angle-to-position scale and linearity with a grating or ruled target of known pitch, measure the lateral point-spread function with sub-resolution scatterers and compare with Δx; then record repeated B-scans of a fixed target and quantify positional repeatability from galvanometer fly-back and timing jitter.
units.failure: 振鏡與相機觸發不同步時，相鄰 B 掃描橫向錯位，體積影像出現鋸齒；掃描軸心偏離瞳孔共軛面則光束在角膜處掃過邊緣被切，視場邊緣訊號下降並出現暈影。~If galvanometer motion and camera triggers are not synchronized, adjacent B-scans shift laterally and the volume shows a sawtooth; a scan pivot displaced from the pupil-conjugate plane lets the beam walk across the corneal edge and be clipped, so signal falls and vignetting appears at the field edge.
units.misconception: 用更高數值孔徑聚焦，OCT 影像在所有深度都會更清晰。~A higher-NA focus makes OCT images sharper at every depth.

units.anchor: 深度比例尺假體與驗收報告~Depth-scale phantom and acceptance record
units.title: 深度比例尺校正、假體驗證與交接~Depth-scale calibration, phantom validation and handoff
units.mechanism: 驗收必須證明深度軸可追溯：用已知厚度與群折射率的玻璃片量其在影像中的像素數，與理論光學厚度比較，確認每像素深度與線性度；用鏡面與中性濾鏡量靈敏度與衰減曲線；用散射假體確認在深度上的點擴散函數與對比。交接文件要記錄光源光譜、k 標定多項式、色散補償係數、掃描比例與所有驗收數據，讓日後任何重建都能重現。~Acceptance must prove that the depth axis is traceable: measure the pixel count of a glass plate of known thickness and group index, compare with its theoretical optical thickness to confirm depth per pixel and linearity; measure sensitivity and the roll-off curve with a mirror and neutral-density filters; and confirm point-spread function and contrast versus depth with a scattering phantom. The handoff record stores the source spectrum, the k-calibration polynomial, dispersion coefficients, scan scales and all acceptance data so that any later reconstruction can be reproduced.
units.model: 每像素深度 Δz_px = z_max/(N/2) = 3514 µm/1024 ≈ 3.43 µm（空氣），6.2 µm 的 δz 約占 1.8 像素。1.000 mm 熔融石英（840 nm 群折射率約 1.467）的光學厚度 1467 µm，預期 428 像素；若量到 430 像素，深度比例尺偏 0.5%，必須回頭修正 δλ 標定。~Depth per pixel Δz_px = z_max/(N/2) = 3514 µm/1024 ≈ 3.43 µm in air, so the 6.2 µm δz spans about 1.8 pixels. A 1.000 mm fused-silica plate (group index about 1.467 at 840 nm) has an optical thickness of 1467 µm and should occupy 428 pixels; a measured 430 pixels means a 0.5% depth-scale error and the δλ calibration must be corrected.
units.verify: 執行驗收清單：玻璃片像素數與線性度（至少三個深度位置）、鏡面加 OD 2 濾鏡的靈敏度、衰減曲線與 w 值、色散補償後的點擴散函數寬度、掃描比例尺；每項附量測條件與日期，連同標定檔一起歸檔。~Run the acceptance list: glass-plate pixel count and linearity at no fewer than three depth positions, sensitivity with mirror plus OD 2 filter, roll-off curve and w, point-spread width after dispersion compensation, and scan scale; attach conditions and date to each item and archive them with the calibration files.
units.failure: 把空氣中的每像素深度直接套用到組織，忽略群折射率約 1.38，所有層厚都高估約 38%；若又未記錄標定檔版本，不同日期的量測無法互相比較。~Applying the air depth-per-pixel directly to tissue while ignoring its group index of about 1.38 overestimates every layer thickness by about 38%; without versioned calibration files, measurements from different dates cannot be compared.
units.misconception: 影像上量到的層厚就是幾何厚度，不需折射率換算。~A layer thickness read from the image is the geometric thickness with no index conversion needed.

example: 設計練習：光譜域 OCT，λ₀ = 1050 nm、光源 Δλ = 100 nm、2048 像素光譜儀覆蓋 110 nm、A 掃描 100 kHz、樣品臂功率 1.5 mW。軸向解析度 δz = 0.441×1.05²/0.100 ≈ 4.9 µm（空氣），組織內 n = 1.38 約 3.5 µm。每像素 δλ = 110/2048 = 0.0537 nm，深度範圍 z_max = 1.05²/(4×0.0537×10⁻³) µm ≈ 5.1 mm（空氣），每像素深度 5.1 mm/1024 ≈ 5.0 µm，δz 約占 1 像素，屬於臨界取樣。光子能量 1.89×10⁻¹⁹ J，曝光 10 µs 內光子數 1.5×10⁻³×10⁻⁵/1.89×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 7.9×10¹⁰，取 η = 0.7 得散粒雜訊極限 ≈ 5.6×10¹⁰ → 107 dB；在半深度 2.5 mm 處以 w = 1.5 估計衰減 −5.3 dB，可用靈敏度約 102 dB。若實測只有 95 dB，7 dB 差距要依序檢查耦合器分光比、光譜儀效率與參考光強度是否落在散粒雜訊主導區。眼睛約 24 mm 的水色散必須以參考臂水槽或數值補償匹配，否則視網膜處的 δz 會明顯寬於 4.9 µm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Design exercise: spectral-domain OCT with λ₀ = 1050 nm, source Δλ = 100 nm, a 2048-pixel spectrometer spanning 110 nm, 100 kHz A-scan rate and 1.5 mW in the sample arm. Axial resolution δz = 0.441×1.05²/0.100 ≈ 4.9 µm in air, about 3.5 µm inside tissue with n = 1.38. Per-pixel δλ = 110/2048 = 0.0537 nm, depth range z_max = 1.05²/(4×0.0537×10⁻³) µm ≈ 5.1 mm in air, depth per pixel 5.1 mm/1024 ≈ 5.0 µm, so δz spans about one pixel, which is critical sampling. The photon energy is 1.89×10⁻¹⁹ J; in a 10 µs exposure the photon count is 1.5×10⁻³×10⁻⁵/1.89×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 7.9×10¹⁰, and with η = 0.7 the shot-noise limit is about 5.6×10¹⁰, i.e. 107 dB; at half depth, 2.5 mm, the roll-off estimated with w = 1.5 is −5.3 dB, leaving about 102 dB usable. If only 95 dB is measured, the 7 dB gap is traced through the coupler split ratio, spectrometer efficiency and whether the reference power sits in the shot-noise-dominated regime. The roughly 24 mm of water in an eye must be matched by a reference-arm water cell or numerical compensation, otherwise δz at the retina is clearly wider than 4.9 µm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1991 年 Huang、Swanson、Fujimoto 等人在麻省理工學院與哈佛醫學院合作發表時域 OCT，以低同調干涉對視網膜與動脈進行微米級斷層成像；1996 年第一台商用眼科 OCT 問世。2003 年前後 Leitgeb、de Boer、Choma 等團隊證明頻域偵測的靈敏度優勢，使光譜域與掃頻 OCT 在 2006 年後成為眼科標準檢查，並擴展到心血管內視鏡與工業量測。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何廠商的專有設計。~In 1991 Huang, Swanson, Fujimoto and colleagues at MIT with Harvard Medical School published time-domain OCT, using low-coherence interferometry for micrometre-scale tomography of the retina and arteries; the first commercial ophthalmic OCT appeared in 1996. Around 2003 the groups of Leitgeb, de Boer and Choma demonstrated the sensitivity advantage of Fourier-domain detection, after which spectral-domain and swept-source OCT became a standard ophthalmic examination from about 2006 and spread to intravascular endoscopy and industrial metrology. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic, not any vendor's proprietary design.
